```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(brms)
library(marginaleffects)
library(collapse)
library(compositions)
library(splines)
```

```{r}
final_df <- readRDS("../outputs/final_df.rds")

model_df <- final_df %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry()

# Focus on URBAN DATA
df_urban <- model_df %>%
  filter(urban_rural %in% "Urban")

# ============================================================
# 1. ILR transformation for demographic composition variables
# ============================================================

cols <- c(
  "pct_0_12",
  "pct_13_21",
  "pct_22_40",
  "pct_41_70",
  "pct_71plus",
  "pct_0car",
  "pct_1car",
  "pct_2plus",
  "pct_none_primary",
  "pct_secondary",
  "pct_tertiary",
  "pct_still_in_edu"
)

# Check that all variables exist
missing_cols <- setdiff(cols, names(df_urban))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "These ILR variables are missing from the new dataset:\n",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Small replacement for zeros before compositional transformation
# ILR cannot handle exact zeros.
df_urban <- df_urban %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(cols),
      ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), NA_real_, .x)
    )
  )

matrix_urban <- df_urban %>%
  select(all_of(cols)) %>%
  as.matrix()

# Replace zeros with small positive value
matrix_urban[matrix_urban == 0] <- 0.001

variables_ilr <- ilr(acomp(matrix_urban))

variables_ilr_df <- as.data.frame(variables_ilr)

names(variables_ilr_df) <- paste0("ilr_", cols[-length(cols)])

df_urban_model <- df_urban %>%
  select(-all_of(cols)) %>%
  bind_cols(variables_ilr_df)



# ============================================================
# 2. Prepare modelling variables
# ============================================================


# Beta regression response must be strictly between 0 and 1
df_urban_model <- df_urban_model %>%
  mutate(
    perc_active_prop = perc_active / 100,
    perc_active_beta = (perc_active_prop * (nrow(.) - 1) + 0.5) / nrow(.)
  )
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 3. Standardize ILR variables
# ============================================================

ilr_vars <- names(df_urban_model) %>%
  keep(~ str_starts(.x, "ilr_"))

df_urban_model <- df_urban_model %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(ilr_vars),
      ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)),
      .names = "z_{.col}"
    )
  )

z_ilr_vars <- paste0("z_", ilr_vars)

# ============================================================
# 4. Model formula with splines
# ============================================================

# Linear ILR terms
linear_predictors <- z_ilr_vars

# Spline terms for kriging and density
spline_terms <- c(
  "ns(krig_value_per_1000_3_18, df = 3)",
  "ns(places_density_km2, df = 3)"
)

formula_beta <- as.formula(
  paste(
    "perc_active_beta ~",
    paste(c(linear_predictors, spline_terms), collapse = " + ")
  )
)

formula_beta

# ============================================================
# 5. Priors
# ============================================================

priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
  prior(normal(0, 2.5), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "phi"))

# ============================================================
# 6. Fit Bayesian beta regression model with splines
# ============================================================

model_urban_krig <- brm(
  formula = formula_beta,
  data = df_urban_model,
  family = Beta(link = "logit"),
  prior = priors,
  chains = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 1000,
  seed = 123,
  cores = 4,
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = 0.97,
    max_treedepth = 12
  )
)

```

```{r}
summary(model_urban_krig)
plot(model_urban_krig)
```

```{r}

# ============================================================
# 8. Convergence checks
# ============================================================

draws_summary <- posterior::summarise_draws(model_urban_krig)

rhat_bad <- draws_summary %>%
  filter(!is.na(rhat), rhat > 1.01)

ess_bad <- draws_summary %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(ess_bulk),
    !is.na(ess_tail),
    ess_bulk < 400 | ess_tail < 400
  )

nuts <- nuts_params(model_urban_krig)

n_divergent <- nuts %>%
  filter(Parameter == "divergent__") %>%
  summarise(n = sum(Value)) %>%
  pull(n)

n_treedepth <- nuts %>%
  filter(Parameter == "treedepth__") %>%
  summarise(n = sum(Value >= 12)) %>%
  pull(n)

convergence_report <- tibble(
  check = c(
    "Rhat <= 1.01",
    "Bulk and Tail ESS >= 400",
    "No divergent transitions",
    "No max treedepth hits"
  ),
  passed = c(
    nrow(rhat_bad) == 0,
    nrow(ess_bad) == 0,
    n_divergent == 0,
    n_treedepth == 0
  ),
  problem = c(
    paste(rhat_bad$variable, collapse = ", "),
    paste(ess_bad$variable, collapse = ", "),
    as.character(n_divergent),
    as.character(n_treedepth)
  )
)

convergence_report

# More diagnostic plots
mcmc_plot(model_urban_krig, type = "trace")
mcmc_plot(model_urban_krig, type = "rhat")
mcmc_plot(model_urban_krig, type = "neff")

```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 9. Marginal prediction for krig_value spline
# ============================================================

model_predictors <- all.vars(formula_beta)[-1]

krig_mean <- mean(df_urban_model$krig_value_per_1000_3_18, na.rm = TRUE)
krig_sd <- sd(df_urban_model$krig_value_per_1000_3_18, na.rm = TRUE)

krig_grid <- seq(
  quantile(df_urban_model$krig_value_per_1000_3_18, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
  quantile(df_urban_model$krig_value_per_1000_3_18, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE),
  length.out = 100
)

newdata_krig <- as_tibble(
  matrix(0, nrow = length(krig_grid), ncol = length(model_predictors))
)

names(newdata_krig) <- model_predictors

newdata_krig <- newdata_krig %>%
  mutate(
    krig_value_per_1000_3_18 = krig_grid,
    krig_value_original = krig_value_per_1000_3_18 * krig_sd + krig_mean
  )

pred_krig <- fitted(
  model_urban_krig,
  newdata = newdata_krig,
  scale = "response",
  probs = c(0.025, 0.975)
)

plot_krig <- bind_cols(
  newdata_krig,
  as_tibble(pred_krig)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Estimate_pct = Estimate * 100,
    Q2.5_pct = Q2.5 * 100,
    Q97.5_pct = Q97.5 * 100
  )

ggplot(plot_krig, aes(x = krig_value_original, y = Estimate_pct)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Q2.5_pct, ymax = Q97.5_pct), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Spline effect of kriged school accessibility",
    subtitle = "Other predictors fixed at their standardized average value",
    x = "Kriged school accessibility",
    y = "Predicted active percentage"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Fitted vs observed values
# ============================================================

# Keep only rows used for prediction
model_vars <- all.vars(formula_beta)

df_fit_plot <- df_urban_model %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(model_vars), ~ !is.na(.x)))

# Posterior fitted mean for each observation
fitted_values <- fitted(
  model_urban_krig,
  newdata = df_fit_plot,
  scale = "response",
  probs = c(0.025, 0.975)
)

df_fit_plot <- df_fit_plot %>%
  bind_cols(as_tibble(fitted_values)) %>%
  mutate(
    observed_pct = perc_active,
    fitted_pct = Estimate * 100,
    fitted_lower_pct = Q2.5 * 100,
    fitted_upper_pct = Q97.5 * 100,
    residual_pct = observed_pct - fitted_pct
  )

# Goodness-of-fit summaries
fit_stats <- df_fit_plot %>%
  summarise(
    RMSE = sqrt(mean((observed_pct - fitted_pct)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    MAE = mean(abs(observed_pct - fitted_pct), na.rm = TRUE),
    correlation = cor(observed_pct, fitted_pct, use = "complete.obs")
  )

fit_stats

# Scatter plot: fitted vs observed
ggplot(df_fit_plot, aes(x = observed_pct, y = fitted_pct)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(0, 100), ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(
    title = "Observed vs fitted active travel percentage",
    subtitle = "Dashed line represents perfect prediction",
    x = "Observed active percentage",
    y = "Fitted active percentage"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```
